name: Covert USB Implant
description: The O.MG Plug appears as a normal charger or USB accessory but contains a wireless-capable HID implant. It can be remotely triggered over Wi-Fi to execute payloads, making it a persistent drop device that does not require physical retrieval to operate. Designed for long-term placement in environments where a device charging from a USB port would not raise suspicion.

blue.det: Device appears as normal charger — difficult to visually distinguish; endpoint may alert on new HID or network device; wireless traffic from implant detectable.
blue.cm: USB device allowlisting; charging-only USB ports in public areas; endpoint monitoring for new device registration; RF monitoring for implant beacon traffic.
